description: Book a same-day delivery for a Shopify order by its name (e.g. #1042) or id. Pickup is the store location, drop-off the order's shipping address, items from the line items. Fetches the order from Shopify if the app has not seen it. force=true ignores the shop's radius and size limits. On success the order is fulfilled with a tracking link as the driver picks it up.

order.description: Order name like #1042, Shopify order id, or the app's order row id

shop.description: myshopify.com domain when several shops are connected

name: book_shopify_order
title: Book a Shopify order
